title: Read the room
description: A week of interviews, competitor teardowns and reading whatever you have already written. I come back with what I think the real problem is.

title: Pick a direction
description: One direction, argued properly, with the reasoning attached. If it is wrong we find out in week two rather than week nine.

title: Build it out
description: The direction becomes a real system: type, colour, layout, components, and the pages that will carry the most weight.

title: Hand it over
description: Files, guidelines and a walkthrough recorded for whoever joins next. Two weeks of support while it goes live.
